sentences.text: 3. As per the F.I.R., on the basis of secret information regarding Sex racket, the informant with other police official raided the Hotel Anita, Hotel Paradise and Hotel Vaishnavi, situated on station road and apprehended many male and female from different rooms of aforesaid Patna High Court CR.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is innocent and she has falsely been implicated in this case.

It is submitted that the petitioner is the owner of the hotel premises and her premises was given on rent by a rent-agreement dated 30.06.2022 to one Chandra Shekhar Pandey,
who is the proprietor of the Hotel Maa Vaishnavi.

It is specifically mentioned in the said rent-agreement that the second party shall use the premises directly for valid and lawful activities,
permissible under law.
It is further submitted that the petitioner has no concern with the said person as she is lessor.

sentences.text: Lastly, it has been submitted that she has no criminal antecedent.
5. Learned A.P.P. has opposed the prayer for bail of the petitioner.

6. Having considered the facts and circumstances of the case and submissions of learned counsel for the parties, in the event of arrest/surrender of the petitioner in connection with Buxar Mahila P.S.
Case No. 66 of 2022, she shall be released on Patna High Court CR.
